rendered:
Under the US Advanced Battery Consortium standard, an EV battery reaches the end of its usable life when its current cell capacity falls below[1] 80%[2] of its rated capacity.
Such end-of-life EV batteries can be reused or repurposed (for example for grid energy storage or behind-the-meter storage), recycled, or disposed of in landfills, which the review says would cause serious environmental issues.[3]
The review says that, regardless of whether batteries are reused, they will eventually need to be recycled.[4]
